notes: Never joined by name: matching is census_code (Schedule C) -> iso2 (Schedule C, same row) -> iso3/numeric (pycountry, by iso2) -> map_feature_id (world-atlas id set, by numeric).

kind_hint is a starting point only; the build step's Partner.kind is set from evidence (this file plus observed SUMMARY_LVL/CTY_NAME) per SPEC PARTNERS, and every code actually observed in acquired data gets a resolution of approved or excluded, recorded in partners.json.

3 codes have no ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 entry in pycountry: 4803, 5082, 5083. These are reported as unmapped per SPEC PARTNERS 'Report every unmapped code' if and only if they are observed live in acquired data; iso3 and map_feature_id are null for them regardless.

No ISO 3166-1 entry for this iso2 in pycountry's official ISO 3166 database; not a UN member state or has no assigned alpha-2 in the standard, so iso3 stays null. kind is country, not special: per CONTRACT.md Published examples (amended), 'kind special is reserved for non-geographic codes; a geographic partner without an ISO 3166-1 code (Kosovo 4803) is kind country with iso3 null.' map_feature_id: checked raw/reference/countries-110m.json (world-atlas countries-110m, pinned npm version, cited in this file's sources) directly for a Kosovo feature; found one entry with properties.name == 'Kosovo' but NO 'id' field at all (verified: this geometry object has only 'type', 'arcs', and 'properties', unlike every ISO-coded country entry which also carries a numeric 'id'). Matching by name alone is not sufficient to set map_feature_id, and no id-bearing property exists to match on instead, so map_feature_id stays null. (Two other geometries in the same file are missing 'id' the same way: 'N. Cyprus' and 'Somaliland', both similarly non-ISO-coded.)

Observed live with SUMMARY_LVL=DET (like a real detail-level partner, not a country grouping) in exports partner_totals for 2013-12 (179871109), 2014-12 (101833), and 2016-12 (1771484) only; absent from imports in every year and from exports in every other configured year. The API returns a null CTY_NAME in every occurrence (raw/<snapshot_id>/partner_totals/exports_{2013,2014,2016}-12.response.json). Code 8220 is absent from raw/reference/schedule_c_country.txt (U.S. Census Bureau Schedule C Country List) and from the API guide (raw/source_test/api_guide/guide.txt). Census does publish a page for this code: https://www.census.gov/foreign-trade/balance/c8220.html (HTTP 200), titled 'Trade in Goods with Unidentified Countries', showing 179.9 million USD of exports for 2013, consistent with the API value 179871109; saved copy at tests/fixtures/published_examples/sources/8220_attempt.txt. Classified kind=special with iso3 and map_feature_id null, consistent with SPEC PARTNERS kind enum. Owner approved on 2026-09-09 under the display name 'Unidentified partner (Census code 8220)': the API gives no name for this code, and the published page gives 'Unidentified Countries'.
